items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And there was another fella named Willie Conray. Willie Conray. Well, like John, like I said, he was the idle banjo player at that time. And everybody used to like to copy. I myself used to copy behind him, you see.

ctx.x: Budweiser? Was it near the Budweiser?

Well, maybe this was the fern, it was the Budweiser and the fern, they were right next to each other. The Vila was the La Vila? La Vila, that's it, that's it. Yeah. John Maria had charge of that job, and he had... It was his job, John Maria to banjo. Well, like I said, I used to always go around, you see. In fact, I can tell you, there's a different place, they had a different place on St. Charles and Cronolette. They had one on Burgundy and Canal. And then, like you said, the La Vila and the Vila were right next…
Well, they didn't, yeah, that's Astor Strutton.
